title: We're trying to enter the Romanian market but the local regulator is asking for a Solvency II internal model validation report and we don't have the actuarial staff to produce one — our pricing team has four people.

record.text: We're trying to enter the Romanian market but the local regulator is asking for a Solvency II internal model validation report and we don't have the actuarial staff to produce one — our pricing team has four people.
record.detail: We submitted our Romanian branch application in late 2023 and the regulator has come back asking for an internal model validation report under Solvency II. This was not unexpected, but we underestimated how much work it involves. Our pricing team is four actuaries, two of whom joined in the last eighteen months and are still working toward their full fellowship exams. The remaining two are fully occupied with Serbia and Bosnia product filings. We have a standard formula model running for our Serbian regulatory returns, so we have the capital model concept — the gap is the formal validation documentation, the backtesting of loss distributions and the narrative that explains why the model is appropriate for our business mix. The Romanian portfolio we are proposing is small: private motor and urban apartment property only, capped at 5,000 policies in year one. We are not looking for someone to rebuild our model; we need someone who understands the Solvency II validation framework and can work with our two senior actuaries to produce a report the regulator will accept. We are targeting submission by October 2025, so the work would need to start by May at the latest.
